meta.name: refactor-safely
meta.description: Restructure existing code safely without changing externally observable behavior. Composes context, design, architecture, code quality, and testing guardrails into a characterization-first refactoring workflow. Use when the user says 'refactor this', 'clean this up', 'untangle this module', 'move this to the right layer', 'simplify this code', or 'improve this structure'.

copy.tagline: 安全重构代码，不改外部行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要改善代码结构而不引入新bug
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code safely without changing behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to improve code structure without introducing bugs
